Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the headquarters city of the manufacturer. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that the Sazerac Company (the manufacturer) has its principal offices in Louisville, Kentucky, the Planner erroneously concluded that the headquarters city was New Orleans, Louisiana. The Planner prioritized the "headquartered in New Orleans" fact from the search snippet over the "principal offices in Louisville" fact, leading to the wrong city being selected for the subsequent search about the first Black mayor. This error propagated through the entire conversation, causing the agents to search for the first Black mayor of New Orleans instead of Louisville.
